configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build, no sanitizers.  Default for running tests.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Debug build with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer compiled in.

configurePresets.name: hip
configurePresets.description: Experimental release build against the HIP backend. Defaults to gfx908 (MI100); override with -DCMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=. Requires the ROCm root on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, e.g. export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/opt/rocm:$CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH

configurePresets.name: cuda-h200
configurePresets.description: Release build against the CUDA backend for compute capability 9.0 (H100/H200). The project default (86, A100) does not cover Hopper, so this preset overrides CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES explicitly.

configurePresets.name: compute-san
configurePresets.description: Release build with -lineinfo; ctest wraps every test executable with compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck.

testPresets.name: default
testPresets.description: Run the full test suite against the Release build.

testPresets.name: hip
testPresets.description: Run the full test suite against the experimental HIP build. ANSStage is excluded on HIP (see Stage::isSupportedOnBackend).

testPresets.name: cuda-h200
testPresets.description: Run the full test suite against the CUDA sm_90 (H200/Hopper) build.

testPresets.name: asan
testPresets.description: Run the full test suite against the ASan+UBSan build. Requires LD_PRELOAD=$(gcc -print-file-name=libasan.so) and ASAN_OPTIONS=protect_shadow_gap=0:detect_leaks=0 to run correctly with CUDA without false positives.

testPresets.name: compute-san
testPresets.description: Run the full test suite under 'compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck'.  Requires compute-sanitizer on PATH.  Each test executable is prefixed via CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR.

testPresets.name: compute-san-stages
testPresets.description: Stage unit tests only, under compute-sanitizer memcheck.

testPresets.name: compute-san-pipeline
testPresets.description: Pipeline integration tests only, under compute-sanitizer memcheck.
